# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User identifies as Srinath and wants explanatory documentation integrated throughout a progressive C++ learning project covering C++11 through C++26, with comprehensive examples and exercises.
- Apply appropriate language and library features in production EquityLens code; demonstrate features that do not fit production through the offline `learn` demo.
- Include detailed Doxygen-format code comments throughout the whole codebase; document interfaces and implementations consistently, matching project guidance.

## Learning Curriculum Guidelines
- For curriculum edits, keep chapter text, learner starters, reference implementations, and navigation links consistent in file names and commands.
- Prefer self-contained offline labs with deterministic inputs and always-on checks; starters should reveal incomplete behavior, while references should pass.
- Gate support-sensitive C++23/C++26 facilities using library feature-test macros and state when a fallback does not provide equivalent guarantees.
- After editing Markdown, verify the requested path exists and contains the saved change to catch path or editor-buffer mismatches.
